openai/gpt-4.1-mini.description: Recommended default. Prime Intellect's own Evaluating Environments guide (docs.primeintellect.ai/tutorials-environments/evaluating) lists this model as "Fast, cost-effective (default)" and uses it as the default model of its inference-backed evaluation command. No Prime-trained model appears on this roster (119 of 125 entries are gateway-routed and the other 6 are third-party models served on Prime infrastructure), so this is the model its docs designate as the default, not a Prime-trained flagship. errorRules.pattern: Authorization header or x-api-key missing|invalid_api_key|Invalid API key
errorRules.message: Invalid or missing Prime Intellect API key. Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Create a key with the Inference permission enabled at {setupUrl}

instructions: 1. Visit: https://app.primeintellect.ai/dashboard/tokens (Settings -> API Keys) and sign in

2. Click Generate New Key and enable the Inference permission — without it requests fail with authentication errors (https://docs.primeintellect.ai/inference/overview); the key is shown only once, so copy it straight away (https://docs.primeintellect.ai/api-reference/api-keys)

3. Billing is automatic deduction from your Prime Intellect account balance (https://docs.primeintellect.ai/inference/overview); no free tier or trial credit is documented on the pages read, so add funds at https://app.primeintellect.ai/dashboard/billing and confirm current terms before the first call
4. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} in your .env file (PRIME_API_KEY, the variable Prime's own docs use, is also read)
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.pinference.ai/api/v1 (docs.primeintellect.ai/inference/overview), a gateway that routes to upstream model providers plus a few models served on Prime infrastructure. The inference host (pinference.ai) differs from the docs and dashboard host (primeintellect.ai); both are confirmed on the vendor's own pages. The catalog schema has no 'unknown' billing value, so no-free-tier here means no free tier is documented, not that the vendor confirmed there is none.

rosterVerified.method: unauthenticated GET https://api.pinference.ai/api/v1/models — 125 models; credential-free, no key used

authProbe.method: unauthenticated GET https://api.pinference.ai/api/v1/models/openai/gpt-4.1-mini with no credentials — 401 {"detail":"Authorization header or x-api-key missing", ...}; only the missing-credential shape was observed, the invalid-key shape (error.code invalid_api_key) is from docs.primeintellect.ai/api-reference/inference-models and was not probed; credential-free, no key used

billingProbe.method: public page https://docs.primeintellect.ai/inference/overview — "Automatic deduction from your Prime Intellect account balance"; https://docs.primeintellect.ai/inference/troubleshooting documents an insufficient_funds error; no free tier stated; credential-free
